ev.q: Among the 208 outbreaks, 107 (51%) started during June–August
The four such cryptosporidiosis outbreaks resulted in a total of 1,380 cases
The 65 (42%) outbreaks caused by Legionella accounted for 354 (12%) of the 2,953 cases
Almost all (199; 96%) of the outbreaks were associated with public pools, hot tubs, or water playgrounds.
Hotels (i.e., hotels, motels, lodges, or inns) or resorts were associated with 71 (34%) of the 208 outbreaks
For the period 2015–2019, a total of 208 outbreaks associated with treated recreational water were reported to CDC.
Unlike other pathogens, which caused outbreaks resulting in <100 cases of illness, Cryptosporidium caused outbreaks resulting in >100 cases of illness.
The June–August peak was driven by 63 outbreaks caused by Cryptosporidium
This report examines data on outbreaks that were associated with treated recreational water
